newsitem.title: CANADA: Loewen says has been in US$1.3 bln in deals.
newsitem.headline: Loewen says has been in US$1.3 bln in deals.

text.p: Loewen Group Inc said on Thursday it has been involved in acquisitions or structured deals worth US$1.3 billion in the year to date.

It has signed or closed US$797 million in acquisitions. And with Blackstone Capital Partners II Merchant Banking Fund L.P., Loewen invested in two highly innovative structured deals worth US$535 million.
These include the US$295 million August 1996 acquisition of Prime Succession Inc, and the US$240 million signed acquisition of Rose Hills, which is expected to close in late November 1996.
Loewen said it invested US$78 million in cash in the Prime transaction and expects to invest US$72 million in cash and US$23 million in property in the Rose Hills transaction.
